The '''Herpetology Award''' was an award gifted to those studying the field of [[herpetology]] by the [[Galactic Science Foundation]].<ref name="Bestiary">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Star%20Wars%20Galaxies:%20Bestiary%20-%20Naboo|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Bestiary &ndash; Naboo}}</ref> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWGdate">{{GalaxiesAED}}, and thus [[Relan Smiff]]'s research on [[fanned rawl]]s, takes place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]].</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Relan Smiff]] was the current recipient of the award.<ref name="Bestiary" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Herpetology Award was mentioned in "Star Wars Galaxies: Bestiary &ndash; Naboo," an article published on the official website for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], published by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="Bestiary" />
